dependsOn.description: HelmReleases the karpenter HelmRelease depends on, keyed by name without the cluster ID prefix. Each value is evaluated as a Go template, so a dependency can be made conditional; only values resulting in `true` are kept.

enabled.description: Whether Kyverno is installed in the workload cluster. When disabled, the karpenter HelmRelease does not wait for the `kyverno-crds` dependency and the chart renders no `PolicyException`, since both need Kyverno's CRDs.
